verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents local inference, a local OpenAI-compatible server, headless mode for CI and the Bionic agent. None of it describes a sandbox or test environment isolated from production data. A community user's habit of testing models locally before moving to vLLM is a user-side workaround, not a product sandbox capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
